transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I guess they brought me in because of what I've been doing at the warehouse. I keep doing things... like, I'll just freeze with my arms up by the forklift. Or I'll start copying the beeping sounds it makes, and the hand signals. 

I also move the boxes in these strange little patterns. Even when everyone is yelling for me to stop, I just keep doing it. So... yeah, that's why they sent me here.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?
No, I... I haven't noticed anything like that. Like, I hear the machines and the normal warehouse sounds, but no voices talking to me when nobody is around. So, no, I don't hear voices.
Since you were a child, have you usually found it hard to understand other people or to connect with them socially?

No, I... I don't think so. Growing up, I had friends and got along with people fine. I never really felt like it was hard to understand them or talk to them. So, no, I didn't have any problems like that as a kid. It's just recently that things have been weird at work.
Before these movements started, had you been sick or had any medical problem?

No, not that I can think of. I've been pretty healthy, honestly. I haven't been in the hospital or had any kind of illness before all this weird stuff started happening at the warehouse. Just... physically fine, I guess.
Have there been times recently when you felt unusually energetic or elated?

No, I haven't really felt like that. I mean, I'm just working my shifts at the warehouse, you know? It's tiring work, moving boxes and stuff, so I'm mostly just worn out at the end of the day. I definitely haven't felt super energetic or, like, unusually happy or anything. Just kind of my normal self, just... dealing with the weird stuff going on.
How long have these strange movements and freezing episodes been going on?
Well, I guess... the freezing up and the weird movements, and just the confusing talking and strange behavior at the warehouse... it's all been happening for about six months now.
